meta.scope: Thailand Batch 2 — Tourism, industrial production, labour force, and ASEAN trade densification.

candidates.title: Tourism arrivals and tourism revenue statistics
candidates.publisher: Tourism Authority of Thailand / Ministry of Tourism and Sports / related
candidates.description: Official statistics on international visitor arrivals and tourism receipts. Tourism is a major services credit in the balance of payments; recent years show arrivals in the low-to-mid 30 millions range and revenue in the multi-trillion-baht range.
candidates.notes: High-centrality services and external-earnings node. Core uniqueness for Thailand.

candidates.title: Industrial production and manufacturing statistics
candidates.description: Industrial production index and manufacturing output statistics. Key segments include automotive, electronics, food, rubber/plastics, petroleum products and related manufactures that underpin export performance.

candidates.title: Labour force and unemployment statistics
candidates.publisher: National Statistical Office / Bank of Thailand related
candidates.description: Labour-force participation, employment and unemployment rates from the Labour Force Survey. Unemployment is typically very low by international standards (around or below 1% in recent readings).
candidates.notes: Primary labour-market statistical product. Structurally low unemployment.

candidates.title: ASEAN merchandise trade statistics
candidates.publisher: Bank of Thailand / Ministry of Commerce related
candidates.description: Merchandise trade with ASEAN partners. ASEAN is a core regional market and production-network partner for Thai manufacturing and agricultural exports.

candidates.title: ASEAN membership and regional economic framing
candidates.description: Framing of Thailand’s founding membership in ASEAN and its role in regional economic integration, production networks and trade liberalisation. Continuously cited in external and industrial strategy analysis.

candidates.title: Thailand tourism–industry–labour–ASEAN densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from TAT, OIE, NSO and BOT sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding tourism arrivals and revenue, industrial production, labour force statistics, ASEAN merchandise trade, and ASEAN membership framing into a coherent activity–services–regional layer.
